tips_en: Read Paper 2, StreamEval, first: its broad, repeated evaluation of interactive streaming tasks exposes major weaknesses in timely instruction following, editing, and state preservation. Paper 1 is the closest companion because FAPL targets controllable, consistent video generation, while Paper 3 offers a robotics analogue focused on reference tracking and cross-object generalization.
tips_zh: 建议先读论文2 StreamEval：它通过广泛且重复的评测，揭示了交互式流式视频在及时执行指令、编辑和状态保持方面的明显短板。论文1与其联系最紧密，FAPL同样聚焦可控且一致的视频生成；论文3则可视为强调参考跟踪与跨物体泛化的机器人学对应工作。
